instruction: Set Chrome to use a dark mode across all websites to help reduce eye strain.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have a native system-wide dark mode feature that forces all websites to render in dark theme. While Chrome has a dark theme for the UI, forcing all websites to display in dark mode is not achievable through Chrome settings alone.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - Chrome does not provide a native feature to force all websites into dark mode
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate marker for tasks that cannot be completed due to technical limitations
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible
This is a valid use case: the instruction asks for functionality that doesn't exist in Chrome
